name: Scouring the Desert
label: Quest
description: Scouring the Desert: the quest giver's words, read aloud by the Lore Forever narrators.

clips.title: Quest text
paras: For some time now, we have been tapping the crystal resources of the Silithus desert. The only dangers we faced were from the creatures that made this place their home and the oppressive sand and dust and heat.
But now the Alliance seems to have caught on to what we have found here. It is now a race between us to capture the natural resources, and keep them from the other.
I need every set of hands that is available. I hope I have yours.

clips.title: Progress
paras: Be wary of the dangers of the desert, friend. With the Alliance lurking in the dunes, any step could be your last.

clips.title: Completion
paras: You've done well, friend. These resources will be added to our stockpiles, and every bit is to our gain and our enemy's loss.
